label: F95zone
description: Unofficial plugin from gamegrab-sources, not part of droidtop and not affiliated with F95zone or F95Checker. Finds F95zone games, links your games to their threads, tells you when a new version is out, and downloads them into your game folders.

provides.label: F95zone thread
provides.linkHint: Thread link or number; blank unlinks

permissions.reason: Searches F95zone and asks F95Checker's public index for thread versions and details
Lets you sign in to F95zone in droidtop's browser view, to see download links and sync your watch list
Tells you when a game you linked has a new version
Games you choose to download are placed in your game folder
